text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Spanish-Portuguese consortium to take over water and electricity network in Rabat and three neighbouring villages.
- Parliamentary commissions hold last talks on regionalisation draft law before adoption.
- King Hassan congratulates Hicham El Guerrouj for setting new 1,500 metres indoor world record.
- Syria tries to avert isolation in the Middle East peace process.
